prompt:
An empty small river landing and ONE moored wooden cargo boat. Camera high above the NORTH stone bank looking SOUTH across the boat into the river. Thus the bank is in the LOWER foreground and water is in the UPPER background; EAST is picture LEFT, WEST is picture RIGHT. Show the entire boat and its two ends, both ends of one boarding plank, stone ledges and mooring post.
The long low boat lies parallel to the shore, LEFT-TO-RIGHT, pointed bow at the LEFT/east and blunt stern at the RIGHT/west. A narrow visible WATER GAP separates the near/north gunwale from the stone bank. Two low old stone ledges descend toward water, ledges parallel to the boat. ONE narrow thick removable wooden gangplank runs FOREGROUND-TO-BACKGROUND perpendicular to the boat, spanning ONLY the water gap; its foreground end rests firmly on the stone ledge and its background end rests firmly on the near gunwale. Show these two supports and water under the middle of the plank. This plank is only one-person wide, much narrower than the boat's width; no railing and no string tied to the plank.
This is a BROAD flat-bottom cargo boat with a wooden DECK around a RECTANGULAR RECESSED central cargo well, not a narrow open canoe. The cargo well is offset toward the FAR side of the boat. On the NEAR/NORTH side, between the gunwale and the recessed cargo-well edge, build a continuous FLAT WOODEN DECK WALKWAY about half a metre wide, visibly three times wider than the gunwale timber. This long deck strip extends left-to-right along the whole hold and is EMPTY: a boatman can put both feet on it and stand next to the boarding plank to lift it. Show its plank surface clearly as a broad band. The boarding plank lands on this deck at its near edge. Three closed woven cargo baskets tied with their own brown cords sit DOWN INSIDE the recessed cargo well, against the FAR edge and ends, never on the deck. Leave empty room for one more basket inside the well. The well has a very low wooden rim, so a basket can be pushed into it. The deck walkway and the cargo floor are visibly separate surfaces. ONE separate mooring rope connects the LEFT/east end of the boat to ONE low stone post on the foreground LEFT/east bank, well clear of the gangplank. The boat stays moored. No roofs, cabins, sails, extra boats or extra planks.
Single continuous location, not a montage or diagram. Native 4K, 16:9. Clean 2D animated film background, fine consistent outlines, broad simple colour shapes, only two shadow levels. Warm grey lit surfaces, cool grey shadows, muted brown timber, grey-beige stone. Ordinary diffuse daylight. Very low material texture, no detailed woodgrain or noise. No people, animals, text, labels, arrows, numbers, money or event outcomes.
